lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Wednesday's packed slate — the San Miguel County BOCC sitting as the Housing Authority to dig into regional affordable housing compliance, Telluride's P&Z taking its first formal look at the school district's employee housing proposal at the middle-high school site, and HARC reviewing the Shandoka Lot Redevelopment on Black Bear Road. Ouray County's Planning Commission also holds three public hearings on Tuesday, including a full repeal of Section 16 of their land use regulations — the kind of code change that tends to matter long after the meeting adjourns. The Mushroom Festival wraps up this weekend, and the Fire District meets Tuesday evening for updates on Station 3 and wildfire assignments.
